standard_prerequisites.name: The regular-model situation, the special fibre as a divisor, and the conormal sheaf of a divisor
standard_prerequisites.statement: In the regular-model situation the special fibre is written as the sum of its irreducible components with multiplicities and is an effective Cartier divisor; for an effective Cartier divisor D on a scheme X the conormal sheaf of D in X is the pullback of the invertible sheaf attached to the negative of D. The author's own situation and his lemma identifying the special fibre as a Cartier divisor are the allowed inputs.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted lemma produces the torsion statement that the chapter uses to control the Picard group and the normal bundle in the analysis of multiple fibres.

core_obligations: Form the divisor obtained by replacing each multiplicity by its quotient by the greatest common divisor of all the multiplicities, and compute its d-th tensor power: multiplying the divisor by d returns exactly the special fibre (source lines 4802-4805).

Use that the special fibre, viewed as an effective Cartier divisor, is principal, so the invertible sheaf attached to it is trivial; hence the invertible sheaf attached to the divided divisor has order dividing d in the Picard group of the model (source lines 4805-4806).

Transfer the statement to the divisor itself: the conormal sheaf of the divided divisor is the pullback of the invertible sheaf attached to its negative, so it inherits the same torsion order, which is the second assertion of the statement (source lines 4807-4810).

proof_roadmap.step: Compute the d-th tensor power of the sheaf attached to the divided divisor as the sheaf attached to the special fibre.
Conclude that the divided divisor gives a torsion class of order dividing d in the Picard group of the model.
Read the same torsion order off the conormal sheaf, which is the pullback of the sheaf attached to the negative divisor.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 Stacks Project 章 models.tex 的 Lemma lemma-multiple-fibre-normal-bundle（源 4792-4799 行，证明 4801-4810 行）：在正则模型情形下，取 d=gcd(m_1,…,m_n)、D=Σ(m_i/d)C_i，则 O_X(D) 在 Pic(X) 中的阶整除 d，且 D 的 conormal sheaf 作为 O_D-模的阶也整除 d。关键操作不是例行核验：证明必须看出 D 的 d 次张量幂恰是 O_X(dD)=O_X(X_k)=O_X（用特殊纤维作为除数是主除数的性质，4802-4806 行），再把这个阶数通过「conormal sheaf = O_X(−D) 的拉回」搬运到 D 上（4807-4810 行）。难点在于把「除以 gcd」这一算术操作翻译成「取 d 次张量幂得到主除数」的代数恒等式，并把同一条 torsion 结论从 X 传递到 D；原文位置在证明的 4802-4805、4805-4806、4807-4810 行。
